description: Describes a single page of a browse/search request against the document library.

members.name: Descending
members.description: Whether to sort descending. Defaults to ascending.

members.name: FolderPath
members.description: Folder to list. Null or "/" is the root. Ignored by flat stores and when Scope is Library.

members.name: Kind
members.description: Which kind of documents to list.

members.name: Scope
members.description: How far the query reaches: Folder (default, the direct content of FolderPath), Subtree (the folder and all of its sub-folders) or Library (the whole library; FolderPath is ignored). A provider without support for the wider scopes may degrade Subtree and Library to Folder.

members.name: Search
members.description: Free-text search across document names. Null or empty returns the folder contents unfiltered. Only honoured when the provider advertises Search.

members.name: Skip
members.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

members.name: SortField
members.description: Field to order results by. Defaults to Name.

members.name: Take
members.description: Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 50.
